title: Integrating Efficient Optimal Transport and Functional Maps For Unsupervised Shape Correspondence Learning
tldr_zh: 用 sliced Wasserstein 距离替代 Sinkhorn 做无监督形状对应特征对齐，加自适应精化，在多个非刚性匹配基准上超过 ULRSSM
tldr_en: Replaces Sinkhorn with sliced Wasserstein distance for unsupervised shape correspondence feature alignment, plus adaptive refinement, outperforming ULRSSM on several non-rigid matching benchmarks
